findings.title: Public group pages only load the first 50 members
findings.body: This now applies pagination to every group, whereas the previous endpoint only limited automatic groups. The public group-members route loads members once, and its template has no pagination controls, so members beyond the first 50 are inaccessible on groups with more than 50 members.

findings.title: Exact multiples of the page size show a phantom page
findings.body: Adding one after `Math.floor` reports an extra page whenever `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (for example, 50 members at a limit of 50 reports 2 pages). The Next control then requests an empty page, and the UI displays a page that does not exist.

findings.title: Removing members from the last page can leave the list on an empty page
findings.body: After a member is removed, `findMembers` computes the request offset using the pre-removal `user_count`. If the removal makes the current last-page offset invalid, the request returns no members and the model keeps that out-of-range offset, leaving the admin list blank until someone manually navigates back.

findings.title: The public members endpoint changes its response shape
findings.body: This replaces the endpoint's serialized array response with an object containing `members` and `meta`. Existing clients of `/groups/:name/members.json` that parse the response as an array will break; this is an unversioned contract change.
